R214.note: th:utext swapped for th:text, Thymeleaf's own escaping attribute; nothing else changes.

R215.note: XmlResolver = null before LoadXml is the documented XmlDocument mitigation; parsing of well-formed payloads and SelectSingleNode are unchanged.

R216.note: IDatabase.HashSet gives length-prefixed RESP framing so CRLF/space in agentNote cannot split the command, but the constructor contract changes from Socket to IDatabase and a new StackExchange.Redis dependency is required, so existing callers no longer compile; the library switch is stated but the caller migration is not called out.

R217.note: (cn={0}) with data in filterArgs is the JNDI escaping mechanism; new SearchControls() is documented as equivalent to the null the original passed.

R218.note: Strict in_array allowlist of exactly the four macro methods ReportRenderer exposes is the only viable fix for a variable method name; the silent return for unknown tokens is stated and only replaces a Call-to-undefined-method Error.

R219.note: Narrow DTO without IsAdmin closes the mass-assignment, but the wire format is switched from gob to JSON (every existing gob client now gets 400) and new validation rejects empty usernames and negative balances the original accepted; both are stated but the no-other-producer claim is an unverified assumption.

R220.note: Sniff + allowlist + decode/re-encode + server-generated name closes the dangerous-type and traversal exposure, but the re-encode degrades stored content (JPEG at quality 75, animated GIFs flattened to one frame) and the response now emits the stored filename in the body, neither of which is stated.

R221.note: eval() removed in favour of a closed arithmetic grammar, which is the right shape, but the grammar rejects PHP arithmetic the original contract accepted (%, **, 1e3 exponent notation), a stated restriction the contract did not call for.

R222.note: Allowlist map is the right fix, but it silently remaps csv_export/pdf_export to plugins.csv_export/plugins.pdf_export, a package the case does not have (the docstring and original import name the plugins as top-level modules), so legitimate requests now fail with ModuleNotFoundError while the write-up claims behaviour is unchanged.

R223.note: Unsaved instance + full_clean() runs the existing validate_file_content magic-byte validator before save(), and the Django ValidationError is mapped to a DRF 400; auto_now_add and FK fields pass full_clean unchanged.

R224.note: @owner placeholder bound via Parameters.Add(SqlDbType.NVarChar) with no truncating size; query shape, using scopes and result mapping unchanged.

R225.note: LIBXML_NOENT dropped so entities are never substituted, LIBXML_NONET added as stated hardening; title/body extraction for a well-formed submission is unchanged, meeting the stated contract.

R226.note: WithValidMethods pins HS256 server-side and the keyFunc HMAC type assertion backs it; the HS256-only assumption is stated and consistent with the 32-byte HMAC secret, so legitimate tokens keep validating.
